decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through-glass vias are central to Plan Optik's announced strategic direction in MEMS and advanced packaging and required substantial technology investment, so management would attribute any slow uptake to long customer qualification cycles and persist.

The carrier wafer was publicly announced in a press release only a year ago, fits naturally into the firm's core glass wafer business at low incremental cost, and its early results can still be explained by temporary market ramp-up.
